The emphasis in this section is on the dynamic plastic design of structural steel beams.Design data have been derived from the static provisions of the AISC Specification with necessary modifications and additions for blast design. It should be noted that all provisions on plastic design in the AiSC Specification apply, except as modified in this chapter.

The calculation of the dynamic flexural capacity of beams is described in detail. The necessary information is presented for determining the equivalent bilinear resistancedeflection functions used in evaluating the basic flexural response of beams. Also presented are the supplementary considerations of adequate shear capacity and local and overall stability which are necessary for the process of hinge formation, moment redistribution and inelastic hinge rotation to proceed to the development of a full collapse mechanism.
